application_process.process_md: **Registration** Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website. Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage. Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha. Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form. Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.” Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email. **Login** Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do) Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha. Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name. Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form. Step 5: Submit the application.

benefits: - 50% of cost of planting material subject to maximum of ₹ 30,000/- per Ha - Ginger growers of NE having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
detailed_description: The ‘Promotion of Exportable Surplus of Identified Spices in the North East: Cultivation of Ginger’, implemented by the Spices Board, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, financial assistance is provided at 50% of the cost of planting material, subject to a maximum of ₹30,000 per hectare. The scheme is applicable to ginger growers in the North Eastern region with land holdings ranging from 0.10 ha to 8 ha, including Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, and other North Eastern states. Designated officials will conduct final inspections and recommend eligible cases.
eligibility: 1. The applicant must be a ginger grower from Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern states. 1. Eligibility is subject to final inspection and recommendation by designated officials.
